Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.openapi

Interface BatchCanonicalOperationResolver

All Superinterfaces:
CanonicalOperationResolver
All Known Implementing Classes:
OpenApiCanonicalOperationResolver
public interface BatchCanonicalOperationResolver extends CanonicalOperationResolver
Optional batch-resolution extension of CanonicalOperationResolver.

Introducing these operations as interface methods allows Spring AOP proxies (both CGLIB and JDK dynamic proxies) to expose batch MVC and scoped bulk resolution without callers downcasting to OpenApiCanonicalOperationResolver or falling back to per-operation scans when beans are proxied.

Trust boundary: resolveMvcOperationsByIds(Collection) inspects Spring MVC handler mappings only and intentionally does not inspect OpenAPI documents across groups. Callers enforcing cross-group bulk identity uniqueness must use resolveByOperationIdsForScope(Collection, Predicate) or CanonicalOperationResolver.requireResourceOperations(String, java.util.List, CanonicalOpenApiGroupSnapshot).

  • Method Details

    • resolveMvcOperationsByIds

      Map<String,BatchCanonicalOperationResolver.ResolvedMvcOperation> resolveMvcOperationsByIds(Collection<String> operationIds)
      Resolves a batch of operationIds from Spring MVC handler mappings only, validating incomplete bulk declarations and rejecting duplicate effective mappings without inspecting OpenAPI documents across groups.

      This method does not verify cross-group OpenAPI collisions and must not replace strict bulk publication verification.

      Parameters:
      operationIds - operation IDs to resolve
      Returns:
      unmodifiable map keyed by resolved operationId in requested order
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when a bulk operation binding is incomplete/ambiguous or an effective operationId maps to multiple handlers

    • resolveByOperationIdsForScope

      Map<String,CanonicalOperationRef> resolveByOperationIdsForScope(Collection<String> operationIds, Predicate<CanonicalOperationRef> scopeFilter)
      Resolves a batch of operationIds from Spring MVC handler mappings first, applies scopeFilter before inspecting OpenAPI documents, and verifies any in-scope declared bulk operations against published OpenAPI documents under a single OpenApiDocumentService.withSchemaCacheReadLock(java.util.function.Supplier) fence.
      Parameters:
      operationIds - operation IDs to resolve
      scopeFilter - optional filter applied before bulk OpenAPI collision verification; null includes all matched IDs
      Returns:
      unmodifiable map of in-scope CanonicalOperationRef entries keyed by operationId
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when bindings are incomplete/ambiguous, duplicate, tampered, or collide across groups
